## Purpose & Scope  
### Purpose  
To establish fraud prevention procedures that:
- Detect unauthorized transactions (fraud)
- Block fraudulent activity before settlement
- Reimburse customers fairly for fraud losses
- Investigate fraud cases
- Prevent repeat fraud by same perpetrator

raw_entities.name: Fraud Prevention Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal policy establishing procedures to detect unauthorized transactions, block fraudulent activity before settlement, reimburse customers fairly for fraud losses, investigate fraud cases, and prevent repeat fraud by the same perpetrator.
context: To establish fraud prevention procedures that: Detect unauthorized transactions (fraud), Block fraudulent activity before settlement, Reimburse customers fairly for fraud losses, Investigate fraud cases, Prevent repeat fraud by same perpetrator

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Transaction
raw_entities.description: Unauthorized transactions representing fraudulent activity that the policy is designed to detect, block, and investigate. This is a primary risk category addressed by the fraud prevention procedures.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Transaction Detection
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to detect unauthorized transactions as part of fraud prevention procedures. This provision establishes the obligation to identify fraudulent activity.

raw_entities.name: Fraudulent Activity Blocking Before Settlement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to block fraudulent activity before settlement occurs. This provision establishes the obligation to prevent fraudulent transactions from completing.

raw_entities.name: Customer Reimbursement for Fraud Losses
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to reimburse customers fairly for fraud losses incurred. This provision establishes the obligation to provide financial redress to affected customers.
context: Reimburse customers fairly for fraud losses

raw_entities.name: Fraud Case Investigation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to investigate fraud cases. This provision establishes the obligation to conduct thorough investigations into suspected fraudulent activity.

raw_entities.name: Repeat Fraud Prevention by Same Perpetrator
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to prevent repeat fraud by the same perpetrator. This provision establishes the obligation to implement measures that stop identified fraudsters from committing further fraud.
context: Prevent repeat fraud by same perpetrator

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customers who are subject to fraud prevention procedures and entitled to fair reimbursement for fraud losses under this policy.
context: Reimburse customers fairly for fraud losses

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Obligation
raw_entities.description: The operational obligation to detect and identify unauthorized transactions and fraudulent activity as part of the fraud prevention framework.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: The process of investigating fraud cases to determine the nature, scope, and perpetrator of fraudulent activity.

raw_entities.name: Customer Reimbursement
raw_entities.description: The obligation to provide fair financial reimbursement to customers who have suffered losses due to fraudulent activity.
context: Reimburse customers fairly for fraud losses
